reason: My register has never lost a bill and I can check it in two minutes at closing. On a busy Sunday my girls won't stop to take selfies and type numbers in an app, so I'd be paying ₹999 a month for something half-filled.
objection: My staff are busy with customers; they won't type everything into an app, and then the numbers in the app will be wrong and I'll go back to the register anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If another salon owner near me showed me it actually caught cash going missing from the drawer, and my staff could bill in under 30 seconds without me forcing them.
